description: Executable rule registry for the methodology's forbidden patterns. Each rule carries trigger/severity/write-block metadata so the same rules can drive static lint, pre-write guards, and CI gates. scripts/py/rule_lint.py consumes this registry; the built-in rules in rule_lint.py remain the fallback when this file is absent.

rules.name: 根目录散落文件
rules.description: Project root only holds AGENTS.md, .editorconfig, build files, and generated adapters.

rules.name: 控制字符
rules.trigger: forbidden control character in a text file
rules.description: Text files must not contain forbidden control characters.

rules.name: 硬编码盘符路径
rules.trigger: local drive path in portable assets
rules.description: Portable assets must not hard-code local drive paths (C:, G:, H:, ...).

rules.name: 私有仓库路径残留
rules.trigger: reference to a private workspace in portable assets
rules.description: Portable assets must not reference the private source repository.

rules.name: 硬编码颜色
rules.trigger: hard-coded color where a theme token should be used
rules.description: Theme variables only; no hard-coded colors when a theme exists.

rules.name: 静默失败
rules.trigger: empty catch/except block hides a failure
rules.description: Empty catch/except blocks hide failures; surface them at the correct severity.
